ModMetaData.name: Rumours
ModMetaData.author: T&B Modding
ModMetaData.description:
Colonists talk about each other. Not all of it is true, and not all of it stays where you put it.
Secrets - A colonist can tell someone something private. It brings the two of them closer, and from then on that person knows something. - Some people keep it. Some people do not. A secret told on is remembered for a very long time by whoever trusted them.
Rumours - Colonists pass on what they think of other people, and it rubs off. Hearing that someone is awful from a person you trust makes you think less of them, whether or not you ever saw anything yourself. - How much it lands depends on who is talking, how much you rate them, and how good they are at it. - Some colonists make things up outright. A rumour can be entirely false and still cost its subject dearly. - A rumour fades. Time, and getting to know the person yourself, undoes it.
Making it right - Colonists can apologise for something they did, which takes the edge off it. It is not free: it costs them to do it, and it does not erase everything.
Who talks - A new trait in three strengths. The discreet keep things to themselves. Gossips cannot help repeating anything. Fabricators invent.
Works with Crew: a rumour from someone in your own crew is believed far more readily than the same words from a rival, and betraying a crewmate's secret can be enough to break the crew apart. Crew is not required.
This mod only changes how colonists feel about each other. It never changes how anyone aims, works or chooses a job.
Requires Harmony. Safe to add to an existing save. RimWorld 1.6, no DLC needed.
